user.title: Approve one reviewed ordinary light
user.description:
Review and trust the private driver.py before continuing. It executes with full Python permissions in HA. Static checks do not prove safety or protocol correctness. This enables only the known bound host and one ordinary light: independent readback and explicitly requested commands. No discovery or manufacturer configuration changes. Independent readback is required after every connection.

Complete light identifier: {identifier}. Driver SHA-256: {driver_sha256}.
